Title: Data Scientist – Agentic AI
Description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

About The Role

You will join Kyndryl’s transversal initiative on Agentic and Generative AI, contributing to the design, implementation, and evolution of data‑ and model‑driven solutions that support both client delivery and internal operational efficiency.

This is a hands‑on, impact‑oriented role, focused on applying AI in real environments.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and architects to build applied AI and agent‑based solutions.
Develop, validate, and evolve machine learning models and LLM‑based components for real business and delivery use cases.
Participate across the solution lifecycle: data exploration, prototyping, validation, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to the development of agents, analytical pipelines, and decision logic, balancing technical quality with practical delivery needs.
Document solutions, experiments, and learnings to support adoption and scalability.
Work in a cross‑functional, evolving environment, interacting with teams at different levels of AI maturity.


If this role sounds exciting but you don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, learning mindset, and potential.

Who You Are

Essential Qualifications:


At least 2 years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or machine learning projects.
Solid skills in Python and some of core data science libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, XGBoost, LightGBM).
Familiarity with neural networks and deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Strong understanding of data preprocessing, handling missing values, unbalanced datasets, and outlier detection.
Genuine curiosity and motivation to learn, experiment, and grow in applied AI.
Spanish native or high level and fluid English.


Education & Certifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Data Science, or related field.

Preferred Skills:


Exposure to data pipelines, ETL processes, and data preparation workflows.
Experience with data visualization and presentation of insights to cross-functional teams.
Postgraduate or Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Data Analytics is valued.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

Title: Senior AI Data Scientist
Description:
About Qualifyze




Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,200 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally.

Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 3,000 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

After securing a series-B funding in September 2024, Qualifyze is now focused on expanding to the US market.




Requirements:




We are looking for an Data Scientist to join our Engineering team! As a Senior AI Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of developing and implementing advanced artificial intelligence solutions. Your role will involve harnessing machine learning techniques and deep learning architectures to solve complex problems and create innovative models that drive business value.




You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven applications and insights.




Main responsibilities:




Design, develop, and deploy AI models and algorithms to address specific business challenges.
Conduct research and experimentation to advance the state-of-the-art in AI and machine learning.
Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to identify opportunities for AI integration.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model selection for optimal performance.
Evaluate and optimize AI models using performance metrics and model validation techniques.
Communicate findings and insights effectively to stakeholders through data storytelling and visualization.
Mentor and guide junior team members in AI concepts, tools, and best practices.
Stay current with advancements in AI technologies and methodologies.




What we're looking for:




Proficiency in Python with a focus on AI libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras).
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and deep learning architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, GANs).
Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and frameworks (e.g., NLTK, SpaCy).
Familiarity with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
Knowledge of cloud platforms for AI deployment (e.g., AWS, GCP or Azure).
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) for collaborative development.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary teams, demonstrating an innovative mindset and a passion for solving challenging problems.
Willingness to learn new AI techniques, with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.




Must have skills:




5+ years of experience in AI, machine learning, or related fields.
Proven experience in developing and deploying AI models in production environments.
Strong foundation in statistics and data analysis as it relates to AI.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product development cycles.




Nice-to-Have Skills:




Experience with reinforcement learning and advanced AI techniques.
Familiarity with ethical AI practices and regulations.
Understanding of business applications and implications of AI technologies.
Experience related to LLMs, Bedrock etc.







What do we offer?




⏳ Flexible schedules throughout the year.

💳 Flexible compensation plan in restaurant/transportation/nursery vouchers.

🌴 25 days of holidays (upgradable to 27 after 2 years and 30 after 4 years in the company).

🏥 Health insurance policy with Assistència Sanitària, with the option to add family members.

🏋️ Wellhub wellbeing platform membership.

🌍 Work from abroad for up to 3 months per year.

💻 All necessary work equipment (laptop, headphones, etc.).

🎉 Two official company events per year to celebrate success.

🚀 Individual coaching and mentoring on your development roadmap within Qualifyze.




At Qualifyze we actively support the power of diversity, uniting complementary talents and perspectives to address new challenges. Our collective strengths help us to find innovative solutions and turn difficulties into opportunities. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs and feels heard.




We are an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

Title: DATA SCIENTIST ADVANCED ANALYTICS
Description:
Descripción del puesto:



¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Sobre el equipo

En Advanced Analytics trabajamos para crear valor para la organización a partir de la explotación de datos. Nuestro equipo colabora transversalmente con 40 áreas del Grupo CaixaBank, creando soluciones con impacto en el negocio: contribuimos a mejorar la toma de decisiones, optimizar procesos, personalizar la relación con los clientes y descubrir nuevas oportunidades de eficiencia y crecimiento.


Además, impulsamos el Analytics Community en CaixaBank, una comunidad orientada a fomentar la cultura data-driven, compartir conocimiento, divulgar buenas prácticas y desarrollar capacidades analíticas, con iniciativas como OlympIA, las Sesiones Analytics, o el Portal de Analítica Avanzada (https://portalanaliticaavanzada.lacaixa.es/). 

 

Sobre la posición

Buscamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para participar en el diseño y desarrollo de casos de uso analíticos, cuya misión es construir soluciones robustas y accionables para resolver problemas de negocio.
La persona seleccionada combinará capacidades técnicas avanzadas y orientación a impacto, trabajando de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, tecnología, datos y otras áreas especialistas. 

 

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollar soluciones analíticas orientadas a resolver problemas reales del banco. Las soluciones suelen involucrar la creación de modelos predictivos, segmentaciones, sistemas de scoring, modelos de optimización o análisis avanzados según las necesidades del caso de uso. 
Aplicar buenas prácticas de validación, interpretabilidad, robustez y monitorización de las soluciones.
Colaborar con áreas de negocio para asegurar que las soluciones analíticas responden a necesidades reales y se integran en procesos de decisión:
Comunicando resultados analíticos de forma efectiva, adaptando el mensaje en función del tipo de audiencia.
Acompañando los equipos usuarios en la adopción de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Contribuir a la preparación de materiales, sesiones, formaciones o contenidos para la Analytics Community.

Requisitos mínimos

Formación

Grado o máster en disciplinas cuantitativas, como ingenierías, Ciencia de Datos, Física o similar.
Se valorará formación específica en Machine Learning, Inteligencia Artificial o Analítica Avanzada.

 

Experiencia

Experiencia previa de al menos 2 años en desarrollo de modelos analíticos, machine learning o ciencia de datos aplicada a problemas de negocio.
Se valorará experiencia en consultoría.
Experiencia colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares, combinando interlocución con negocio y desarrollo técnico.
Se valorará experiencia en industrialización, monitorización o puesta en producción de modelos.

Competencias clave

Excelente nivel de programación en Python para análisis de datos, modelización y automatización.
Conocimiento sólido de librerías de data science y machine learning (p.ej. scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy)
Excelente nivel de SQL/Big Query para extracción, transformación y análisis de datos.
Buenas prácticas de documentación, reproducibilidad y calidad del código.

Nice to have:

Experiencia con plataformas cloud, en particular GCP.
Conocimiento de herramientas de visualización y BI, p.ej. QlikSense o Looker.
Experiencia con modelos de IA generativa.
Conocimiento de MLOps: versionado, monitorización y control de performance.
¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.  
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

Title: Data Science
Description:
¿Te gustaría trabajar en un proyecto internacional de inteligencia artificial y ciencia de datos, participando en el desarrollo y mejora de soluciones avanzadas de procesamiento de documentos mediante LLMs, VLMs, OCR y Machine Learning?




En Capitole buscamos un/a Data Scientist con experiencia en modelos de lenguaje, procesamiento de lenguaje natural y extracción de información no estructurada, para incorporarse a un proyecto estratégico en un entorno global e innovador.




🧩 Responsabilidades del puesto

🔹 Diseñar, prototipar y evaluar soluciones de IA, LLMs y Machine Learning para la extracción, clasificación y transformación de documentos complejos.

🎯Must Have

🔹 +3 años de experiencia profesional en Data Science, Machine Learning o IA aplicada, con dominio de LLMs, Generative AI y Prompt Engineering.

🔹 Sólida base en NLP y ML tradicional, con capacidad para evaluar cuándo un enfoque clásico o determinista es superior a un LLM.

🔹 Excelentes competencias de programación en Python (testing, control de versiones, reproducibilidad) y conocimientos estadísticos para validar hipótesis y métricas.

🔹 Experiencia práctica trabajando con datos no estructurados/semiestructurados, diseño de schemas y creación de datasets de evaluación.

🔹 Fluidez en inglés y habilidades de comunicación para explicar decisiones y trade-offs técnicos a perfiles no técnicos.

🔹 Titulación universitaria en Informática, IA, Data Science, Matemáticas, Ingeniería o campo afín.




Requisitos deseables

🔹 Experiencia en Document Intelligence y OCR (especialmente Azure Document Intelligence).

🔹 Manejo de plataformas gestionadas de IA como Azure OpenAI o Amazon Bedrock.

🔹 Conocimientos en clasificación de documentos, extracción de información, NER o modelos multimodales (VLM).

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Como uno de nuestros Data Scientists de Juegos

Serás una de las personas clave que ayuda a transformar preguntas de negocio en insights accionables. Investigarás y analizarás el comportamiento de los jugadores para generar recomendaciones basadas en datos. Para ello, escucharás a los distintos miembros del equipo, comprenderás el contexto y cuestionarás ideas de negocio cuando sea necesario.

Nuestros Data Scientists utilizan una amplia variedad de técnicas, como estadística frecuentista y bayesiana, machine learning, análisis exploratorio y explicativo de datos, inferencia causal, visualización de datos, modelización Monte Carlo, análisis econométrico, entre otras. La amplitud de estas responsabilidades requiere una gran capacidad de aprendizaje, eficiencia en el trabajo colaborativo y habilidad para comunicar datos e insights de forma clara y efectiva.

Los Data Scientists de Juegos son profesionales que impulsan la toma de decisiones de negocio mediante el uso de datos y análisis profundos.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con conjuntos de datos grandes y complejos, disfrutando de la autonomía necesaria para generar un impacto significativo en el éxito de nuestros juegos. Además, formarás parte de un equipo experimentado y altamente cualificado de aproximadamente 20 profesionales, con múltiples oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

Qué harás


Colaborar con los stakeholders para entender y definir los requisitos de análisis.
Realizar análisis exploratorios de datos y convertir los hallazgos en preguntas que puedan responderse mediante técnicas analíticas.
Utilizar analítica avanzada, métodos estadísticos, inferencia causal, machine learning u otras técnicas para responder preguntas y resolver problemas de negocio.
Comunicar los resultados de forma clara y efectiva.
Gestionar requisitos poco definidos o ambiguos.
Explicar análisis complejos e ideas técnicas de manera sencilla y comprensible.
Trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos complejos.
Mantener una actitud de aprendizaje continuo, adquiriendo nuevas habilidades y metodologías relacionadas con la ciencia de datos, la comunicación o la gestión de stakeholders.
Utilizar una amplia variedad de herramientas y enfoques de ciencia de datos.


Qué buscamos


Titulación universitaria o experiencia equivalente en un área orientada a los datos.
Capacidad para utilizar técnicas de visualización de datos con el fin de comunicar análisis e insights de manera efectiva.
Experiencia utilizando alguna de las siguientes disciplinas para responder preguntas de negocio o científicas: estadística, matemáticas, machine learning, econometría, inferencia causal, modelización Monte Carlo, entre otras.
Experiencia trabajando con R y/o Python.
Conocimientos y experiencia en SQL.


¿Por qué Product Madness?

Como parte de la familia Aristocrat, compartimos su misión de llenar de alegría la vida gracias al poder del juego, con un equipo de primer nivel que crea títulos líderes y de mayor recaudación en el género de casino social, entre ellos Heart of Vegas, Lightning Link y Cashman Casino.

Con un equipo global de 800 personas, Product Madness tiene su sede en Londres, y oficinas en Barcelona, Gdańsk, Lviv, Montreal y un equipo remoto en Estados Unidos, lo que nos convierte en una auténtica potencia global.

Nos guiamos por nuestro principio de “Las personas primero”. Independientemente de dónde, cuándo o cómo trabajen, los miembros de nuestro equipo tienen oportunidades para avanzar en su carrera profesional y crecer con nosotros. Nos enorgullece fomentar una cultura inclusiva, en la que se anima a cada persona a dar lo mejor de sí misma cada día.

Pero no confíes solo en nuestra palabra. En 2024, fuimos incluidos en la lista de los Global Inspiring Workplace Awards y recibimos un premio de bronce en los Stevies for Great Employers, en la categoría de “Empleador del año - Medios de comunicación y entretenimiento”.

Disponibilidad para viajar

Ninguna

Información adicional

En este momento, no podemos tramitar visados de trabajo para este puesto. Los candidatos deben tener permiso para trabajar a tiempo completo en el país donde se ofrece la vacante, sin necesidad de visado ahora ni en el futuro.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Descripció de l'empresa




Dribia som un estudi d’innovació en ciència de dades: dissenyem algoritmes d’optimització i predicció a partir de la detecció de patrons en les dades. Despleguem els nostres algoritmes per crear solucions de software a mida basades en analítica avançada de dades i intel·ligència artificial.

Som un equip amb experiència, creatiu i potent tècnicament. Combinem una contrastada trajectòria en consultoria privada en ciència de dades amb una sòlida formació acadèmica. Hem executat projectes per empreses de diversos sectors que inclouen: previsió de vendes, optimització de processos, recomanació de productes, previsió de fugues de clients o anàlisi del llenguatge natural entre d’altres.

Aquest talent el canalitzem a través d’una metodologia àgil pròpia, específica per a projectes de dades i àmpliament validada. Lliurem solucions completes end-to-end basades en codi obert, documentat i totalment transferible als nostres clients (sense restriccions d'IP i llicències). A més, proveïm del suport necessari perquè el client pugui integrar i operar amb les solucions lliurades autònomament




Descripció de tasques




Projecte amb client

Els equips en un projecte de desenvolupament estàndard consisteix en un equip de dedicació total 1.4 FTE1. Aquest equip està liderat per un responsable de Projecte (RP) al 40%, un o dos desenvolupadors principals (Dev), amb un total de dedicació del 100%, i un possible suport amb dedicació variable. Aquesta dedicació pot variar en funció de

l’experiència del científic de dades, dels requisits del client i de les particularitats del projecte. En general l’activitat de projecte es duu a terme a les oficines de Dribia (o en remot) i, si les condicions ho permeten, les presentacions de final d’sprint es duen a terme a les oficines del client (1 dia cada dues setmanes).

A Dribia som conscients que la creativitat requereix diàleg i perspectiva. En aquesta línia, a part de l'equip amb dedicació intensiva en el projecte, setmanalment organitzem seminaris de discussió sobre els projectes actius, on l'equip de Dribia al complet contribueix al disseny i resolució de problemes.

A Dribia participem de tot el cicle de vida dels projectes i, per tant, un cop entreguem les nostres solucions, també ens encarreguem del seguiment, resolució d’incidències i millores. Aquestes tasques poden estar articulades per bossa d’hores o per una dedicació constant. Sigui quina sigui la fórmula, trimestralment obliguem el client a dedicar les hores no utilitzades en millores incrementals de la solució i, per tant, afegint una part més creativa al

manteniment típic de solucions desplegades.




Projectes interns

Sempre que algú tingui disponibilitat, incentivem la dedicació en la millora d’eines internes: desenvolupament de solucions pròpies, llibreries pròpies, snippets de codi, documentació interna, etc. Si es considera oportú, aquestes eines es poden alliberar i publicar en llicències de codi obert. La metodologia de treball en els projectes interns serà la més similar possible a la feta servir amb els clients. Iterativa i entregables cada 2 setmanes.




Redacció de propostes.

Els científics de dades Sènior poden donar suport a l’equip comercial en la redacció de propostes sobretot en la definició de la solució algorítmica i planificació, així com la dedicació aproximada per a cada una de les fases. No s’envia cap proposta comercial a un client sense l’acord de l’equip de projecte proposat. Si es requereix una defensa presencial de la proposta, hi participa tot l’equip, on cada u es presentarà i el responsable del projecte defensarà la part tècnica i planificació del projecte.




Desenvolupament d’eines internes i formació

Incentivem preparar i dur a terme sessions de formació interna per tal de difondre les noves eines desenvolupades, coneixements que es creguin rellevants o compartir reptes dels projectes. Aquestes sessions les anomenem Pizza Slides i es duen a terme cada un o dos divendres a les oficines abans de dinar (dinar a càrrec de Dribia).




Requisits dels candidats

Llicenciatura o grau amb un alt contingut en matemàtiques i estadística (per exemple física o matemàtiques) amb experiència en desenvolupament de programari en Python. Els coneixements en algorítmia i/o intel·ligència artificial són desitjables però no imprescindibles. Per sobre de tot valorem el talent, la comunicació, la creativitat, i

l’organització.

Data Scientist Júnior

Grau + mínim de 2 anys d’experiència en programació.

Data Scientist

Experiència de 4 anys en programació (sigui màster o laboral) o un doctorat amb ús intensiu de l’estadística i la programació.

Sènior Data Scientist

Experiència de 6 anys en programació i experiència laboral de 3 anys en el sector privat de les ciències de dades.

Mànager Data Scientist

Experiència mínima de 2 anys com a Sènior Data scientist a Dribia.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist — Machine Learning for Marketing 📍 Barcelona · Full-time




Most marketing decisions are still made on instinct. We help the world's most sophisticated advertisers replace that instinct with evidence.




Indaru is an independent media and data advisory firm. We combine senior consulting judgement with advanced analytics to answer the questions that matter most to large advertisers: what is our marketing actually delivering, what should we change, and what happens if we do? Our work sits behind multi-million-euro investment decisions at some of the largest brands in the world.




We're looking for a Data Scientist who is genuinely excited about applying machine learning to real commercial problems — and who wants their models to shape decisions, not sit in a notebook.




What you'll work on You'll join a team of data scientists building the models and measurement that guide our clients' marketing investment. Day to day, that means:

Developing machine-learning models applied to marketing — Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), forecasting, segmentation and attribution
Contributing to our proprietary products: AITA, our MMM platform, and EcoMetrics, our ISO-aligned solution for measuring the carbon footprint of digital advertising
Turning model output into clear, defensible recommendations clients can act on
Building and optimising the data pipelines (ELT) that bring together Google Ads, Meta, Google Analytics, YouTube and Amazon data
Designing and maintaining dashboards in Looker Studio, Shiny, Power BI and similar tools
Presenting your findings directly to clients — your analysis, in your words




What we're looking for

Essential

Strong Python for data science (pandas, scikit-learn and the wider ecosystem) and comfort working with large datasets (GB–TB scale)
Solid SQL — able to write and reason about complex queries
A rigorous, detail-oriented and self-directed way of working
A genuine collaborator who enjoys working closely with colleagues and clients
Strong written and spoken English (C1)
A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a related quantitative field

Nice to have

Experience with deep-learning or Bayesian frameworks (TensorFlow, Keras, PyMC, PySpark)
Familiarity with a cloud platform (Google Cloud, AWS or Azure)
Exposure to marketing, media or advertising data
Additional languages — we work across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific




Don't tick every box? If you're strong on the essentials and keen to grow into the rest, we'd still like to hear from you.




What we offer

A front-row seat on high-stakes measurement work for global brands — exposure most data scientists wait years for
Proprietary products at the frontier of MMM and sustainability measurement
Real ownership of your work and direct client contact early on
A serious commitment to developing your potential — we treat growth as part of the job, not a perk
A collaborative, open team that takes the work seriously without taking itself too seriously
Full-time position based in Barcelona, with a competitive salary

Planificar, ejecutar y hacer seguimiento de proyectos complejos con enfoque en cumplimiento de plazos y alcance

Asegurar altos estándares de calidad en los entregables generados.

Experiencia de al menos 3 años en proyectos de Data Science y Machine Learning.
Grado en ingeniería o similares
Conocimiento de Python, SQL y herramientas de visualización de datos
Experiencia en la comunicación de los resultados de los análisis desarrollados.
Voluntad de asumir nuevos retos de desarrollo personal en el área de la aplicación de analítica avanzada y Big Data a problemas reales de negocio.
Nivel alto de inglés.

Summary

Location: Barcelona, Spain

Relocation Support: This role is based in Barcelona, Spain. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support. Please apply only if this location is accessible.

As a Senior Expert Data Science, you will play a key role in delivering impactful data science solutions, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and expert peers to transform complex project needs into meaningful outcomes for patients and the organization.

About The Role

Key Responsibilities


Project manage own tasks and works with allied team members; plans proactively, anticipates and actively manages change, sets stakeholder expectations as required, identifies operational risks and drives issues to resolution, minimizes surprise escalations, with initial support from supervisors
Understand life science data sources including preclinical, clinical, sales, contracting, promotions, social media, patient claims and Real World Evidence
Research and co-develop with supervisor in data management, new algorithms, methods, statistical models and business models and providing insight into structured and unstructured data
Support the evaluation of the need for technology and novel scientific software, visualization tools and new approaches to computation to increase the efficiency and quality of the Novartis practices
Independently identifies research articles and proposes them for application to Novartis business problems
Develop automation for data management, repeatedly refreshing analysis and generating insights
Understand complex and critical business problems, formulates integrated analytical approach to mine data sources, employ statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to contribute to solving unmet medical needs, discover actionable insights, and automate processes for reducing effort and time for repeated use.
Manage the implementation and adherence to the overall data lifecycle of enterprise data from data acquisition or creation through enrichment, consumption, retention, and retirement, enabling the availability of useful, clean, and accurate data throughout its useful lifecycle.
High agility to be able to work across various business domains. Integrate business presentations, smart visualization tools and contextual storytelling to translate findings back to business users with a clear impact.


Essential Requirements


4+ years of relevant experience in Data Science
Track record delivering global solutions at scale.
In-depth mastery of external environment and trends
In depth knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning
Experience in Python is a must
Professional level of English, both written and spoken
Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across functions and teams.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
ABOUT US

In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best-in-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.

LIFE AT TKWW

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

TKWW is looking for a Senior  Data Scientist to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior  Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment
Partner with engineers to ensure appropriate and scalable tracking is in place

 

REQUIREMENTS:
Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Strong business acumen and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and decision frameworks
Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment through data-driven insights and recommendations
Advanced knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, and forecasting
Hands-on experience with experiment design, analysis, and rollout of A/B and multivariate tests
Advanced SQL skills and ability to write efficient, production-ready queries
Strong Python skills for data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analysis
Knowledge of data modeling and experience partnering with engineers on data infrastructure
Experience prioritizing and managing analytical work, data assets, or product backlogs in a cross-functional environment
Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field preferred
2+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, with some prior leadership, mentorship, or project ownership experience
Fluent in English & Spanish  

WORK MODEL:

This role is Together@TKWW-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You’ll be expected to work in the office two days a week as part of our hybrid work model.

 

  

#professional 

AI FLUENCY

At TKWW, AI is a tool that helps our teams work smarter, move faster, and spend more time on the work that matters most. We expect every employee, in every role, to build fluency with the AI tools relevant to their work, use them thoughtfully and with sound judgment, and bring curiosity as these tools keep evolving. This isn't about replacing our people's expertise — it's about equipping every employee to use AI to raise the bar on the work we do together.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

Commit to our customers: You act as one team on behalf of our customers. You lead with head and heart, and build what matters for life's most meaningful moments.
Raise the bar: You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
Be all in: You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
Celebrate impact: You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way.  You love to win, together.

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We provide meaningful, high-impact benefits designed to support the holistic well-being of our diverse workforce and help our people thrive both professionally and personally. From physical and mental wellness to flexible time off our programs are built around the moments that matter most.

TOGETHER@TKWW: OUR APPROCH TO HYBRID WORK

Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

TKWW is looking for a Senior  Data Scientist to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior  Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
  • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
  • Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
  • Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
  • Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
  • Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment
  • Partner with engineers to ensure appropriate and scalable tracking is in place

 

REQUIREMENTS:
  • Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong business acumen and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and decision frameworks
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment through data-driven insights and recommendations
  • Advanced knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, and forecasting
  • Hands-on experience with experiment design, analysis, and rollout of A/B and multivariate tests
  • Advanced SQL skills and ability to write efficient, production-ready queries
  • Strong Python skills for data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analysis
  • Knowledge of data modeling and experience partnering with engineers on data infrastructure
  • Experience prioritizing and managing analytical work, data assets, or product backlogs in a cross-functional environment
  • Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field preferred
  • 2+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, with some prior leadership, mentorship, or project ownership experience
  • Fluent in English & Spanish  

WORK MODEL:

This role is Together@TKWW-eligible and based near one of our office hubs. You’ll be expected to work in the office two days a week as part of our hybrid work model.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As one of our Games Data Scientists you will be the business facing masterminds who help turn business questions into actionable insights. You research and analyze player behaviour, and come up with recommendations. Data Scientists do this by listening to team members, understanding context and challenging business ideas. Data Scientists use diverse techniques - frequentist and Bayesian statistics, machine learning, exploratory and explanatory data analysis, causal inference, data visualization, monte carlo modelling, econometric analysis, etc. Such broad requirements call for the ability to learn quickly, work efficiently with peers and communicate data clearly and effectively. Games Data Scientists are true visionaries who support business decisions with data and in-depth analytics.

You will have the opportunity to work with large and complex data sets, with the autonomy to make a huge impact on the success of our games. You will also be working as part of an experienced and highly skilled team of 20 with opportunities to learn and develop.

What You'll Do
Discuss with stakeholders requirements for analysis
Run exploratory data analysis and turn it into questions which can be answered with analytical techniques
Use simple analytics, statistical or causal inference, machine learning or any other techniques to answer questions and address problems
Communicate results clearly and effectively
Take care of unclear and ambiguous requirements
Communicate complex ideas and analyses in a simple way
Work independently on complex projects
Be willing to acquire new skills and learn new methodologies, whether related to stakeholder management, communication or data science
Be able to use diverse data science tools and approaches


What We're Looking For
A degree or equivalent work experience in data driven field
Ability to use visualization techniques for communicating data and analysis
Experience of using any of the following to answer business or scientific questions -statistics, mathematics, machine learning, econometrics, causal techniques, monte carlo modelling, etc.
R/Python experience
Knowledge and experience of SQL


Why Product Madness?

As part of the Aristocrat family, we share their mission of bringing joy to life through the power of play, with a world-class team who creates top-grossing, leading titles in the social casino genre, including Heart of Vegas, Lightning Link, Cashman Casino. With 800 team members across the globe, Product Madness is headquartered in London, with offices in Barcelona, Gdańsk, Lviv, Montreal and a remote team spanning the USA, making us a truly global powerhouse.

We live by our People First principle. Regardless of where, when, or how they work, our team members have opportunities to elevate their careers, and grow alongside us. We take pride in fostering an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to be their very best, every day. But don’t just take our word for it. In 2024, we made the Global Inspiring Workplace Awards list, and won a bronze award at the Stevies for Great Employers in the ‘Employer of the Year - Media and Entertainment’ category.

So, what’s stopping you?

Travel Expectations

None

Additional Information

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you a data enthusiast ready to make an impact? Join our team as a Data Scientist, where you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our company’s future through sharp analysis, strategic insight, and proactive collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Machine Learning


Develop and implement end-to-end projects powered by advanced AI tools to solve and automate key business problems and processes.
Develop and deploy traditional machine learning models (Classification/Regression).
Foster an AI-driven culture within Holaluz by researching and disseminating AI knowledge across the company.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and assess their suitability for Holaluz.


Data Warehousing


Populate the Data Warehouse with datasets using Python and SQL to create robust data pipelines.
Optimize and evolve the data warehousing infrastructure to ensure cost-effectiveness and scalability.
Maintain the smooth and efficient operation of Data Analytics systems.


Insight Generation & Analytics


Answer business questions using a wide range of data techniques.
Develop concise one-page documents with actionable insights and business recommendations.
Conduct in-depth analyses to solve key business problems.
Translate complex data into clear and concise presentations for senior management and stakeholders, effectively communicating key findings and recommendations.
Create compelling visualizations to effectively communicate key metrics to stakeholders.


What We're Looking For

Education & Experience


A Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field
3–5 years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist or Data Engineer.


Key Skills & Attributes


Technical Proficiency: Expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation, analysis, and automation.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Proven ability to dissect complex problems and deliver strategic solutions.
Communication & Storytelling: Strong ability to distill intricate technical concepts into clear, actionable business insights.
Proactive Mindset: A detail-oriented, solution-focused professional with high standards for data accuracy.
Collaboration: Dependable team player who thrives both independently and in collaborative environments.
A positive, energetic attitude that aligns with our SHAKE culture:
Say things as they are
Have fun
Always people first
Keep rowing together
Es posible

Complementary Skills And Experience


Workflow Orchestration: Hands-on experience with orchestration tools like Apache Airflow.
Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or QlikView.
Version Control: Strong understanding of version control best practices using Git.
Cloud Platforms: Previous experience working within cloud environments, specifically AWS, is highly appreciated.


Why Join Us?

This role is more than just a job, it's an opportunity to drive meaningful impact within a fast-paced, forward-thinking organization. If you consider yourself an optimistic person, dedicated and excited to grow within a culture of transparency, collaboration, and possibility, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Scientist - Analytics and ML
Description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

As Data Scientist – Machine Learning and Analytics, you will make the operational data of OCC Assistant Manager — SITA's AI-powered Operations Control Center solution for airline disruption management — speak: automatically reconstructing disruptions from Ops Control and Crew Control data, explaining how airlines resolved them and quantifying the value created by OCC Assistant Manager.

You will analyze operational database changes such as delays, aircraft swaps, crew swaps and operational activities, build trusted analytical models, measure OCC Assistant Manager usage and solution quality, and create business cases that show airline savings.

Reporting to the Head of Disruption Management Solutions (OCC Assistant Manager), you will be part of the OCC Assistant Manager team.

What You'll Do


Design and build the databases, data models and processes needed to analyze operational data
Reconstruct operational disruptions automatically from Ops Control and Crew Control database changes
Aggregate events such as aircraft swaps, crew swaps, delays and operational activities into a clear view of what happened during the day
Analyze how the airline resolved each disruption, whether OCC Assistant Manager was used and whether OCC Assistant Manager proposed good solutions
Create customer-facing reports, dashboards and business cases that quantify OCC Assistant Manager value, savings and operational impact
Create internal KPIs, metrics and management reporting to improve the product and understand customer operations
Apply machine learning where it adds value: disruption detection, pattern detection, forecasting, anomaly detection or risk scoring
Support Science, onboarding and automatic OCC Assistant Manager configuration with exploratory analysis and data-driven insight


Qualifications

EXPERIENCE


Demonstrated ability to write advanced SQL queries and analyze complex operational database changes over time
Proficiency in Python for data processing, event aggregation and analysis, using pandas, scikit-learn or similar
Ability to define KPIs, value metrics and business cases that connect operational events to customer savings
Proven capability to identify patterns in operational changes and determine when to use machine learning versus simpler analysis
Experience building clear dashboards and analytical products that explain disruptions, resolutions and OCC Assistant Manager value
Ability to validate whether data is correct from an operational and business perspective
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical, operational and customer-facing stakeholders
A curious, rigorous mindset, comfortable with messy real-world operational data
Motivation to learn airline OCC workflows, crew-control concepts and the OCC Assistant Manager data model


NICE-TO-HAVE


Experience with airline operations, Ops Control, Crew Control, OCC KPIs or disruption management


What We Offer

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

🌎 Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

🌿 Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

🚀 Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

🙌 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍Barcelona, Spain | 💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits

Hybrid model: 3 days a week in the office

About Our Data Science Teams

We're looking for a Senior Product Data Scientist excited to help build the bank of the future. You'll have the opportunity to super charge our user engagement and help us to build a bank that customers truly love.

At Monzo, we're building a bank that is fair, transparent and a delight to use. We’re growing extremely fast and have over 15 million customers in the UK. We’ve built a product that people love and more than 80% of our growth comes from word of mouth and referrals.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. And we're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives data scientists the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.

How We Hire

We are excited to be expanding and are hiring for multiple roles across our Data Science teams! Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth, or Core, we are looking for talented individuals with a versatile skill set to contribute across our squads. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!

Your day-to-day


Applying your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand how our users interact with our products and how those insights can inform our product strategy
Guide and enable product teams to measure things that matter; initiate or help run A/B experiments to keep improving everything we do
Drive together with the finance team a unified company-wide understanding of the lifetime value of our users and how different product features are impacting user profitability
Liaise with engineers to keep making sure we collect the right data to produce relevant business insights


You Should Apply If


You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, product, users and very importantly your colleagues as well
You're commercially minded and can put numbers into business perspective
You’re as comfortable getting hands-on as taking a step back and thinking strategically
You have a self-starter mindset ; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so
You're a team player whom your colleagues can rely on
You have solid grounding in SQL and preferably Python
You have experience in conducting large scale A/B experiments


The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:


Recruiter Call
Initial Call
Technical Interview
Final Interview including a case study and collaboration interview


Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.

What’s In It For You

💰 Base salary for this role is depending on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits

📍Barcelona, Spain

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of €1,200 a year for books, training courses and conferences

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

Title: Data Scientist | Catalog Games
Description:
Craft:

Job Description:

Your Role Within Our Kingdom

We are looking for a dedicated and creative Data Scientist to join the Product Development and Experimentation teams in Catalog Games! You will help shape the future of our games through deep data insights that unlock player behaviors and business opportunities. As part of a diverse and talented analytics community, you’ll support multiple teams in creating entertaining, data-driven experiences for millions of players.

Working closely with game designers, developers, and other data scientists, you will define experiments, drive actionable insights, and continuously evolve how we understand and enhance our games.

Key Responsibilities:


Design, analyze, and present results from A/B tests to inform feature and game development.
Conduct rigorous data explorations and develop models that uncover new opportunities.
Deliver clear and impactful visualizations and presentations tailored to diverse audiences.
Ensure data quality and accessibility to support informed decision-making across teams.
Support the evolution of Catalog Games’ data science methodologies and tooling.
Collaborate across games to share insights, tools, and learnings that benefit the broader portfolio.
Systematically break down abstract problems into concrete analytical questions.


Skills to Create Thrills

Analytical & Technical:


Strong background in applied statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling.
Advanced proficiency in SQL for working with large-scale, complex datasets (300M+ players).
Skilled in Python or R for statistical analysis, modeling and automations.
Deep understanding of statistical methodologies, including A/B testing and experimental design.
Experience with big data platforms (e.g., GCP/BigQuery, AWS…).
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau).
Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git), and experience in collaborative programming.


Business & Communication:


Strong business insight: able to frame product questions into structured analyses.
Effective communicator: present data stories clearly and influence diverse stakeholders.
Collaborative mindset: ability to work cross-functionally and guide decision-making.


Tasty Bonus Skills


Experience with mobile game analytics or in-game advertising.
Interest in agentic workflows (Codex, Claude…)
Contributions to data science communities or internal capability-building initiatives.


A Great Saga Needs All Sorts of Heroes

Making games is fun—especially with people who share the same passion. At King, we embrace diversity and believe it leads to more creative solutions and richer game experiences. If you're excited about data, games, and working in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and join us in Making the World Playful. Applications need to be in English.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Title: Growth Data Scientist
Description:
Smadex is a leading advertising technology company founded in Barcelona in 2010 and sold to American-based and stock-listed Entravision in 2018 (NYSE::EVC). We are one of the top mobile ad-tech companies in the world and the largest Demand Side Platform (DSP) based in Europe, with our revenues over +$100M and consistently growing +40% YoY over the past years. And with an incredible 100% growth last year.

Our mission is to continue to improve our ad-tech platform, especially the core of it, our algorithms, to help our clients achieve their programmatic advertising campaign goals. We want to give our employees a job they’ll love, where they will be challenged to improve results through real-life engineering and data analysis and where everyone’s implication has an impact.

We are looking for a Growth Data Scientist to work closely with internal and external teams to help advertisers achieve their business goals and improve the effectiveness of Smadex Ads. The candidate should be communicative and analytical, in order to answer the complex questions that Product and Campaign performance are facing. For this purpose we use tons of data available to get powerful insights to resolve them, creating effective strategies to help improve the Smadex platform!

This is a full-time position based in Barcelona.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities


Dive deep into complex datasets, covering the behavior of millions of users and apps worldwide, to extract actionable learnings that inform high-level strategy and stakeholder understanding
Partner with business and technical teams to drive rigorous analysis and testing, identifying key opportunities to maximize the performance and effectiveness of Smadex campaigns.
Collaborate with stakeholders to channel market insights and performance data into our roadmap, directly influencing Product and ML strategies to enhance our platform's capabilities.


Skills And Requirements


+3 years of experience as a Data Analyst / Data Scientist
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a Quantitative Field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Sciences,.)
Strong problem-solving skills, ability to formulate questions, run analysis to articulate a recommendation.
Proven working knowledge of Python, SQL and large data sets, understanding of analytic methodologies for data evaluation.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and conclusions.
Strong knowledge and experience of statistical concepts and hypothesis testing.
Knowledge of the ad-tech industry is a plus.


Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered.

What Is In It For You


Integrate a highly motivated and young team.
Great compensation package.
Top location at the heart of Barcelona in a penthouse office with a rooftop terrace, barbeque, and a fully stocked fridge.
Work from home: 2 days/week
Private Health Insurance
Access to LinkedIn Learning
Meal vouchers - Tickets Restaurant monthly allowance.
Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR Gym and Wellhub
Monthly TGIF events.
Regular team-building events.
Fun and friendly work environment with talented marketers and engineers from over 40+ countries
And more!

The complexity of our subscription model, along with the unique dynamics of tutor-learner interactions, offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to make a real impact.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be a key player in shaping the future of our product and driving our strategy forward. Embedded within a cross-functional squad, you’ll collaborate closely with product managers, tech leads, designers, and other key stakeholders to deliver data-driven insights that shape business decisions.

Our Data Team is dedicated to empowering top-quality decision-making. Do you want to know how? Visit our Tech Radar to learn about the technologies we use at Preply!

Title: AI Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist- AI




Barcelona, Spain

Hybrid- 2 days a week




We’re looking for a Data Scientist to help build and improve AI‑powered document processing solutions used across a large, complex organisation. You’ll work across LLMs, multimodal models, OCR, NLP and classical ML to turn messy, unstructured business documents into reliable structured data that drives real value.

In this role, you’ll design and evaluate approaches for document extraction, classification and validation — “Design, prototype and evaluate approaches for document extraction, classification, validation and transformation.” You’ll also work with highly variable formats — “Work with complex and variable formats, including multi‑page documents, tables, line items and inconsistent layouts.”




What you’ll do

Develop and optimise prompts, structured outputs, validation logic and post‑processing components.

Run experiments, analyse failure patterns and iterate to improve accuracy and reliability.
Create reproducible Python workflows and contribute reusable components for extraction, validation and data prep.
Collaborate with Product, AI Engineering and business teams to translate requirements into measurable data science problems.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.




What you’ll bring

3+ years in data science, machine learning or applied AI.
Hands‑on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering and experimentation.
Strong NLP/ML fundamentals and the judgement to know when classical methods outperform LLMs.
Solid statistics — enough to judge whether a performance change is real.
Experience with unstructured or semi‑structured documents.
Python skills that make your work reproducible and easy for engineers to productionise.
Good coding practices: testing, version control, code review, reproducible experiments.
Ability to explain technical trade‑offs clearly.
Comfortable diving into business domains to understand what “correct extraction” actually means.




Nice to have

Document intelligence / OCR (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence).
Experience with managed AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock).

Our Team

Our Team

  • Machine/Deep Learning to elucidate disease trajectories, patient subtypes, define underdiagnosed conditions, and unmet health needs;

People

  • Mentor analysts on advanced analytics and RWE techniques; conduct technical workshops and training sessions

Process

  • Work together and lead research analytical projects, including project conceptualization and design;

Performance

  • Experience: 8+ years’ experience; High level proficiency in at least two or more technical or analytical languages (R, Python, SQL); experience with advanced ML techniques (neural networks/deep learning, reinforcement learning, SVM, PCA, etc.) and causal inference methodologies (propensity score methods, inverse probability weighting, doubly robust estimation); confounding adjustment techniques; comparative effectiveness research design; survival analysis (Kaplan-Meier, Cox models, competing risks); longitudinal data analysis methods; Strong healthcare data analysis expertise, expertise in data analysis techniques, and good understanding of healthcare datasets (EHR, Claims, RCTs), and data structures; Expertise in use of statistical methods to investigate real-world problems (e.g., patient journey, time to event analysis); Advanced experience in preparing, analysing, and managing large healthcare datasets in interventional and/or non-interventional studies; Ability to prototype analyses and algorithms in high-level languages embracing reproducible and collaborative technology platforms (e.g. GitHub, containers, jupyter notebooks); Exposure to NLP/LLM technologies and analyses; Knowledge of some data visualization technologies (ggplot2, R shiny, plotly, d3, Power BI);

Title: Staff Data Scientist - Experimentation
Description:
Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us💫.

Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology.




The Challenge 🧩

We are seeking an experienced Experimentation lead who will own the evolution of Wallapop's experimentation practice. This person will define the company's experimentation standards, improve statistical rigor, increase the speed and quality of product decisions, and help Product teams adopt a culture of evidence-based decision making.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Executive leadership to ensure experiments are designed, executed, analyzed, and interpreted consistently across the organization. You will be both a hands-on expert and an internal consultant, helping teams answer critical questions about marketplace growth, personalization, search, discovery, trust & safety, monetization, and seller experiences.




What You Will Do👇

Experimentation Strategy: Define Wallapop's experimentation vision and roadmap, establish company-wide standards, create frameworks for experiment prioritization, and develop guardrail metrics and governance.
Statistical Excellence: Own methodology across the company and introduce advanced techniques (CUPED, sequential testing, network effect measurement, marketplace methods, quasi-experimental designs, and incrementally measurement) to reduce decision latency.
Product Partnership & Enablement: Act as a strategic advisor and coach to Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and PMs on hypothesis development, experiment design, and success metrics to raise overall experimentation maturity.
Education: Build Wallapop's experimentation curriculum, deliver training programs for PMs, Designers, Engineers, and Analysts, and establish playbooks and office hours.
Platform & Tooling: Partner with Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering to improve infrastructure, evolve Amplitude Experiment data practices, and define quality standards for exposure logging.
Marketplace Optimization: Design experimentation approaches for search ranking, recommendations, personalization, marketplace liquidity, supply-demand dynamics, seller growth, trust & safety, and ads monetization.




What We’re Looking For 🔍

Technical Expertise:8+ years of total experience in data science, product analytics, or causal inference, including at least 4 years deeply focused on experimentation (experimental design, statistical inference, A/B testing, and variance reduction).
Tooling & Code: Strong SQL proficiency along with experience using Python or R.
Product Partnership: Proven ability to partner directly with Product organizations and influence senior stakeholders using strong business judgment.
Leadership: Demonstrated success building experimentation cultures, experience coaching PMs and analysts, and excellent communication skills.




What Would Be A Plus 🚀

Experience in Amplitude
Experience working in marketplaces, e-commerce, consumer internet, or two-sided platforms.
Experience with recommendation systems or search systems.




Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals.

Wallapop is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone.

We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package.




Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits:

Generous individual learning budget of 2K per year
Free office meals, lunch selection from different providers
Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day
Private Health Insurance with Alan
Flexible working hours + intensive Fridays
Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check)
Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office
Generous referral Program & Charity Donation
Bonus for weddings & newborns
Wallapop Renta (Tax income support)
Monthly product advantages (Wallapop Club)
Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises
Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll
One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office
Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable
26 holidays per year
TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows)




What does the hiring process for this position look like? 👀 **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.**

Intro Call - run by talent acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. This usually takes 45-60 minutes.

Task - you will be assigned a task to submit within 5 up to 7 days where you will be able to showcase your expertise and technical skills required for the role.

Expertise Interview - run by the hiring team, focus on the required core skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60-90 minutes.

Stakeholder Interview - run by relevant stakeholders reflecting the reality of the context of the role, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes.

Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes.

Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

Title: VIE Barcelone (12 mois) - Data Scientist H/F
Description:
Intégré à l’équipe du Data & IA Hub, vous rejoindrez une jeune équipe composée de Data Scientists, Data Engineers et ML Engineers.




Vous travaillerez sur deux missions principales :




En mode projet, vous participerez au pilotage de A à Z de projets finaux : collecte des données, pipeline de prétraitement, modélisation et déploiement. Vous contribuerez au développement des 4 axes principaux du groupe :
Inspection 4.0 : développements d’algorithmes de computer vision et NLP en soutien aux experts métiers sur le terrain
Assistants SOCOTEC : développement d’agents personnalisés pour les services du groupe (RAG, text-to-SQL, …)
IA+X pour des nouveaux services : développement de technique d’hybridation entre physique et IA (jumeau numérique, PINN)
Extraction d’information à partir de documents et de plans
Vous choisirez un sujet de R&D pour vous confronter à l’état de l’art du domaine avec des possibilités de publication scientifique. Les sujets sont présentés et détaillés ci-après:
Inspection 4.0 : Machine learning appliqué à l’inspection des ouvrages d’art
Détection de presque accident sur chantier assitée par IA : EPILOG
Auto-completion de contenu technique pour assister à la rédaction des rapports
Agent de génération de rapport avec canevas intégré dans une plateforme LLM
Agent de Knowledge Management (AXONE IA, RESOTECH IA) employés des techniques de RAG avancés
Smart speech-to-text : transcription et extraction intelligente d'informations avec des LLMs




Le travail sera fait en collaboration avec une équipe de développeurs pour développer les modèles et héberger les livrables sur une plateforme web AWS.




Un niveau courant en Espagnol et en Anglais sont nécessaires à l'accomplissement des missions.

Vous ferez preuve d’autonomie, de sagacité et de qualités certaines dans la rédaction et la communication de son code.
