Title: Global Data Scientist Specialist
Description:
WHO WE ARE

Avolta is the world’s leading travel experience player. With a traveler-centric philosophy and a geographically diverse network, the travel retail and F&B company addresses the needs of up to 2.3 billion passengers each year, with 5,500 outlets in more than 75 countries across six continents. Guided by their Destination 2027 strategy and boosted by their recent combination with travel F&B giant Autogrill, the company is well positioned to realize their ambition to create a Travel Experience Revolution through their many locations at airports, motorways, cruise lines, seaports and railway stations amongst others.




PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Global Data Scientist Specialist will leverage advanced analytics and data science to unlock insights that drive strategic decisions and operational excellence across Avolta’s global IT landscape. This role is pivotal in transforming complex data into actionable intelligence, enabling innovation and supporting the company’s vision of revolutionizing the travel experience. This role will be based in Madrid with hybrid flexibility.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Identifies emerging analytic trends, data needs, and innovative solutions to address business challenges
Collaborates with the Analytics Business Analysts and key stakeholders to generate hypotheses and develop models that answer impactful business questions
Design and implement statistical models to extract meaningful insights from large datasets
Parses, cleanses, and manipulates structured and unstructured data for analysis
Conduct quality assurance testing to ensure accuracy and reliability of models
Works with data sourcing teams to develop, test, implement, and maintain analytic models, including attribute identification, exploratory data analysis, and data transformation
Partners with business teams to review data sources, resolve inconsistencies, and validate business logic for data discovery initiatives
Performs advanced text, quantitative, statistical, financial, and operational analyses.
Designs, builds, and scales end-to-end ML pipelines, enabling efficient data processing, model training, deployment, and monitoring in production environments




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience: Proven track record in data modeling using leading analytics tools and relational data structures
Technical Skills: Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, with solid understanding of databases, data modeling, and data structures
Machine Learning Expertise: Strong foundation in machine learning techniques, including model selection, performance evaluation, and validation; experience with model explainability, interpretability, and auditability to ensure transparency and reliability in production environments
Big Data & Cloud: Hands-on experience with modern cloud-based data platforms, such as Databricks and familiarity with scalable data architecture
Collaboration: Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, business analysts, and data teams
Communication Skills: Strong communication and storytelling abilities, with a clear focus on translating complex analytical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders and business users
Languages: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Personal Competences: Team worker, able to lead and support others, and contribute to growth within a collaborative and agile team environment
Data Product Mindset: Experience delivering end-to-end data products, from data ingestion and modeling to deployment and business adoption
Visualization Skills: Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI, to effectively communicate insights and support decision-making

Te integrarás en un equipo especializado en analítica de datos dentro del sector bancario, participando en el diseño, desarrollo y evolución de soluciones analíticas orientadas a mejorar la toma de decisiones y la personalización de productos.

🔹 Trabajar en entornos Cloud sobre AWS, especialmente con Amazon SageMaker.

🔹 Participar en todas las fases del ciclo de desarrollo: análisis, diseño, implementación, pruebas y mantenimiento.

🔹 Garantizar la calidad, escalabilidad y robustez de las soluciones desarrolladas.

Física
Matemáticas
Ingeniería Informática
Ingeniería Aeroespacial

✅ Experiencia demostrable trabajando con:

Python
PySpark
SQL

✅ Experiencia en entornos AWS, especialmente con Amazon SageMaker.

✅ Experiencia en diseño, desarrollo, despliegue y mantenimiento de modelos de Machine Learning.

✅ Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma cubriendo el ciclo completo de desarrollo de soluciones analíticas.

✅ Perfil analítico, proactivo y orientado a resultados.

✅ Capacidad para trabajar en entornos colaborativos y multidisciplinares.

✔ Experiencia en modelos de recomendación.

✔ Experiencia en modelos predictivos orientados al negocio.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its

comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing

the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range

of application areas. As a family-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in

Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about

our solutions and innovations, visit our website here.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with experience developing machine learning solutions and analytical models, from experimentation to validated production-ready models. You will work closely with the Product Owner, Data Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and Data Analysts to transform business challenges into scalable AI solutions and data products.

What You’ll Do


Design, develop, and validate machine learning models through iterative experimentation and PoC cycles.
Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business problems, define use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
Develop forecasting, predictive, and analytical models, with strong focus on time series use cases.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and MLOps Engineers to deliver AI and ML solutions efficiently.
Perform feature engineering, model validation, and model performance analysis.
Build demo-ready PoCs and visualizations to communicate results and insights to stakeholders.
Track experiments, metrics, and model evolution using MLflow.
Work with analytical datasets and contribute to the definition of datasets and features for ML use cases.
Contribute to technical standards, best practices, and AI/ML solution design.


What We’re Looking For


4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role focused on analytical and ML solutions.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong background in machine learning.
Experience managing ML experimentation cycles, model lifecycle, and production model maintenance, using tools such as MLflow or similar.
Proficiency in Python and experience working with SQL.
Experience working with analytical databases and large datasets.
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and notebook-based experimentation workflows.
Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Analytical mindset, fast learner, collaborative attitude, and customer-oriented approach.
Experience working in Agile environments.


Our offer


Permanent role.
Hybrid working model (3 days of remote work/week).
Flexible working hours.
30 business days of annual leave.
Flexible remuneration plan.

¿Qué estamos buscando?

 

Actualmente contamos con vacantes en Madrid y Bilbao para un/a Data Scientist especializado en el diseño y desarrollo de modelos predictivos y de inferencia  para unirse a un equipo de datos en crecimiento y participar en la construcción de productos analíticos escalables y de alto impacto que quieran desarrollar su carrera profesional en GFT. Buscamos personas entusiastas, con iniciativa y ganas de seguir aprendiendo, que deseen crecer en un entorno multicultural, dinámico, colaborativo y lleno de retos.  

 

 

Tus principales responsabilidades serán:


Aunque dependerán de tus conocimientos y experiencia aportada, en general las principales funciones que llevarías a cabo con nosotros serían:

 

Identificar casos de uso susceptibles de resolverse mediante ML.
Diseñar, entrenar y validar modelos predictivos.
Desarrollar modelos de scoring, clasificación, clustering y propensión.
Trabajar en casos de uso relacionados con Customer Scoring, KYC, riesgo y personalización.
Realizar feature engineering y análisis exploratorio.
Definir métricas y procedimientos de evaluación.
Trabajar conjuntamente con Data Engineering para industrializar modelos.
Utilizar la plataforma de datos como fuente de información para entrenamiento e inferencia.
Participar en el diseño de capacidades de ML reutilizables.

    

Requisitos:

 

Experiencia de 6 años o más en rol similar
Python y SQL.
Machine Learning supervisado y no supervisado.
Scoring y modelos de inferencia.
Feature engineering.
Evaluación y monitorización de modelos.
GCP y ecosistema de ML.
BigQuery.
MLOps.
Muy valorable experiencia en riesgo, KYC, fraude, propensión o scoring en banca.

 

Competencias personales:

 

Trabajo en equipo
Habilidades de comunicación, favoreciendo dinámicas que permitan el flujo de conocimiento, con interés tanto en aprender como en enseñar.
Proactividad en la búsqueda de nuevas soluciones y mejoras

 



Ofrecemos:



 

En GFT consideramos que la diversidad es uno de nuestros pilares fundamentales y promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo basado en la cooperación y el respeto mutuo. Ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todas las personas sin tener en cuenta su raza, origen cultural, sexo, edad, orientación sexual, identidad de género, discapacidad o creencias religiosas. GFT dispone y ha registrado un Plan de Igualdad que recoge las medidas a adoptar con el objetivo de alcanzar en la empresa la igualdad de trato y de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres y a eliminar, si es que la hay, la discriminación por razón de sexo.

 

¡Únete a nuestro equipo global!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About The Role

The data science team, currently 11 members, focuses on pricing, classification of open banking data and credit decisioning. All data scientists actively contribute to building Render and adapting it to different use cases and products, by being directly embedded in the tech team. As we launch in Spain, we're hiring our first local data scientist to build out the credit risk model for the Spanish market, working closely with both our local Spanish team and our London-based Data Science team.

What You'll Be Doing


Work with our local Head of Credit Risk to build and develop the local credit risk model for the Spanish market, from initial development through to ongoing iteration and performance monitoring
Evaluate, select and integrate local data providers (bureau, Open Banking, alternative data) to power credit decisioning in Spain
Own reporting for the Spanish business: designing the dashboards, metrics and analytics infrastructure that give the team visibility into portfolio performance, risk and affordability
Work closely with the London-based data science team to adapt Render to the Spanish market, sharing methodology, code and lessons learned across geographies
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. product, finance, collections, underwriting, and the local credit risk and country leads) to translate data insights into pioneering solutions that drive product strategy and growth in Spain
Stay abreast of industry trends in AI, machine learning, and fintech to drive innovation


Who You Are


You have an advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field
You’ve got 3+ years of experience in a data science role. Credit risk or finance experience is a plus but not required, as you'll be supported by strong local expertise from our credit risk lead and country director
Strong SQL & Python skills and experience working directly with large datasets
You have a strong background in statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
You're passionate about leveraging AI and data to improve financial inclusion and access to fair credit
You have excellent communication skills and can translate complex data insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable working across English and Spanish
You're adaptable, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Experience with AWS is a plus

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics
Description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Madrid

Compensation: €95,000 - €115,000 / year

Description

Location: Madrid, Spain

Annual Remuneration: €95,000 - €115,000 and discretionary annual bonus

Pay Frequency: Monthly

Probationary Period: 180 days

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3-days per week

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics based in Madrid.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:


Taking ownership of Kharon's risk propagation and entity analytics system — the engine that evaluates entities in our knowledge graph and surfaces meaningful risk signals to customers
Designing and implementing complex analytical logic that translate nuanced geopolitical and financial risk into structured, interpretable outputs
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and graph-based ML systems that power risk scoring and entity analysis
Partnering closely with Research, Product, and Engineering teams to understand evolving risk frameworks and translate them into robust, maintainable systems
Iterating on the system's architecture to increase the complexity and precision it can handle — this is not a rip-and-replace, but a thoughtful evolution of a system already in production
Exploring how LLMs and other AI techniques can be integrated to handle increasingly complex risk logic


Qualifications


A proven interest or experience in global security, financial crimes, sanctions, export controls, or related domains
4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, with demonstrated ownership of production systems
Strong foundation in statistics and the ability to apply quantitative methods to complex, real-world problems
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and working with graph databases or knowledge graph structures
Experience with graph analysis, graph ML, or network analysis — professional experience is a strong differentiator
Comfort working across research and data engineering contexts — this role spans all three
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and API development
Strong product instincts — able to go deep technically while staying aligned to customer and business outcomes
Bonus: Experience with LLMs or AI-assisted analytical systems


About Kharon

Kharon operates at the nexus of global security and is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible.

From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

Disclosures

Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

If you require any adjustment to participate in the recruitment process, please contact apply@kharon.com. You must have the right to work in Europe and Spain. Kharon is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that Kharon will process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation and Spanish data protection legislation. For information about how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice at www.kharon.com/privacy. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, to object to or restrict its processing, and to lodge a complaint with the Spanish data protection authority, the AEPD, at www.aepd.es. To exercise your rights, contact us at apply@kharon.com.

If your application is unsuccessful, your data will be retained for up to 12 months before being securely deleted. If you accept a role, your data will transfer to your employee record.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
Job Description | Junior Data Scientist

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated Junior Data Scientist to join a growing data team focused on transforming large volumes of data into actionable insights. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong quantitative background who enjoys solving complex problems using statistical methods, machine learning, and programming.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop analytical models, identify business opportunities through data, and contribute to data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
Develop, validate, and optimize statistical and machine learning models.
Apply advanced analytical techniques, including multivariate statistics, predictive modeling, and network analysis.
Clean, transform, and prepare structured and unstructured data for analysis.
Build reproducible analytical workflows using Python and/or R.
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
Present findings and recommendations through clear visualizations and reports.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytical methodologies and best practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline such as Physics, Engineering, or another field with a strong mathematical and statistical foundation.
Ideally, a Master's Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related field.
1 to 2 years of experience working on analytical or data science projects.
Strong understanding of statistical methodologies, including multivariate analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and network analysis.
Experience working with large datasets and performing data preparation, transformation, and analysis.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.
Good knowledge of SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Professional proficiency in English.

Nice to Have

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience with big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop.
Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Matplotlib.
Knowledge of version control using Git.

What We're Looking For

Curious and data-driven mindset.
Passion for statistics, machine learning, and solving real-world problems.
Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
Eagerness to learn new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.
Proactive attitude and ownership of assigned tasks.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€38,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join an international project focused on developing and improving AI-powered document processing solutions.

In this role, you will work with LLMs, Vision-Language Models, OCR, NLP and Machine Learning to transform complex unstructured business documents into structured data.

You will collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Engineers, Product teams and business stakeholders to develop and evaluate solutions that deliver measurable business value.

If you enjoy solving complex Data Science challenges and experimenting with AI to solve real business problems, this could be your next challenge!

🔹 Design and improve AI solutions for document extraction, classification, validation and transformation.

🔹 Develop prompts, structured outputs, validation and post-processing logic for complex document formats.

🔹 Build datasets and evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy and continuously improve solution performance.

🔹 Develop automated evaluations and regression tests to ensure robustness when models or pipelines change.

🔹 Write clean, reusable Python code and translate successful experiments into production-ready solutions with AI and Data Engineers.

🔹 Work with Product and business stakeholders to define use cases, success criteria and measurable AI solutions.




💡 Must Have

🔹 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning or Applied AI.

🔹 Hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI, including prompt engineering and experimentation.

🔹 Strong understanding of NLP, Machine Learning and statistics, including when classical or deterministic approaches are more appropriate than LLMs.

🔹 Experience working with unstructured or semi-structured data, datasets, ground truth and evaluation metrics.

🔹 Strong Python skills and good practices around testing, version control and reproducible experimentation.

🔹 Experience analysing results and translating findings into measurable improvements.

🔹 Fluent English and spanish and ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

🔹 Degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.




✨ Nice to Have

🔹 Experience with Document Intelligence and OCR, particularly Azure Document Intelligence.

🔹 Experience with managed AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI or Amazon Bedrock.

🔹 Experience with document classification, information extraction or NER.

🔹 Experience applying multimodal or Vision-Language Models to document content and layouts.




🏢 Hybrid model – 2 days on site per week




🌍 Why join this project?




🤝 People first – diverse and inclusive culture in an international environment.

📊 Work on high-impact Data & Insights initiatives across business performance, operations, finance, and commercial domains.

Madrid (Hybrid, 2 days onsite)

Permanent

€48,000 - €53,000 p/a




Our client is an IT consultancy operating on a global scale who are looking to hire a Data Scientist to join their Core Modelling team. They are looking to recruit a Data Scientist who can get properly stuck into the core modelling work.




You’ll be working as part of a small team to build, train and evaluate machine learning models alongside senior team members who’ll guide you through the trickier problems. Cleaning, processing and exploring client data to find the patterns that matter

Update and restrain existing foundation models as new data comes in
Working on the pipelines that get models from notebook to production
Presenting results clearly and for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Turn analysis into reports and visualisations using Tableau and Python




The Successful Data Scientist will have:

Previous experience in a Data Science role where you have gained a solid grounding in statistics, probability and core Machine Learning algorithms
Proficiency in Python including data manipulation libraries such as pandas or NumPy
Strong SQL skills for data extraction and manipulation
Experience with data visualisation libraries (malplotlib, seaborn, plotly) and creating reports in tools like Tableau
Strong teamworking skills but also the ability to work independently
Previous experience processing and exploring data in the iGaming sector would be an advantage but generally an industry involving predicting human behaviour in purchasing such as retail or banking could be suitable




If this sounds like the kind of challenge you’d actually enjoy, apply with your CV. If you have any questions please contact Adam on +44 7425 559 243.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Desde LHH Recruitment Solutions seguimos colaborando con una prestigiosa empresa del sector seguros, en pleno proceso de Transformación con el objetivo de posicionarse como la compañía referente dentro del sector seguros. Como parte de este ambicioso reto, actualmente buscamos un/a:




Data Scientist




MISIÓN

Únete a la transformación de Santa Lucía y marca la diferencia resolviendo retos reales de negocio con datos e impacto directo en el cliente y en los resultados de la compañía.







RESPONSABILIDADES DEL PUESTO

Colaborar con los responsables de su propia unidad y con el resto de las áreas de negocio y técnicas en la definición y desarrollo de proyectos analíticos, de Machine Learning y de IA, incluyendo IA generativa, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos y expectativas, supervisando los entregables comprometidos e informando de avances, bloqueos y riesgos potenciales de forma proactiva.
Trabajar de la mano con las distintas áreas del Grupo Santalucía y la Red Agencial para entender en profundidad los problemas de negocio, aplicando escucha activa y teniendo en cuenta las particularidades de cada unidad en la definición de soluciones basadas en datos e IA.
Analizar la información existente y proponer nuevas aproximaciones que permitan enriquecerla, incluyendo el uso de datos estructurados y no estructurados, con el objetivo de resolver retos de negocio mediante soluciones analíticas y de IA tradicional y generativa.
Diseñar, evaluar y evolucionar soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas a casos de uso reales, asegurando su alineación con los objetivos de negocio y con los estándares técnicos del grupo.
Definir cuándo utilizar modelos de IA generativa frente a modelos de machine learning tradicionales, reglas u otros enfoques analíticos, aplicando criterio técnico y de negocio.
Diseñar y mantener soluciones de IA integradas con datos corporativos, así como definir diferentes métricas de utilidad para el negocio, y para el equipo de Data Science.
Promover el uso responsable y controlado de los datos y de la IA dentro de la compañía, conforme a las políticas internas de seguridad, privacidad, cumplimiento y a los estándares de calidad y legalidad establecidos.
Aportar capacidades de tratamiento y preparación del dato cuando sea necesario, como soporte a soluciones analíticas y de IA, garantizando la calidad de la información utilizada.
Interpretar los resultados de modelos analíticos, de Machine Learning y de sistemas de IA generativa, identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer estrategias alternativas, comunicando de forma clara los procesos y conclusiones tanto a perfiles técnicos como de negocio.
Definir y supervisar KPIs para monitorizar modelos analíticos y soluciones de IA, incluyendo métricas de rendimiento, calidad, uso, costes, latencia, posibles drifts y métricas de gobierno.
Liderar proyectos de Data Science y AI de manera individual o en colaboración con otros miembros del equipo y con equipos de consultoría externos, actuando como referente técnico.
Mantener y mejorar soluciones analíticas y de IA ya existentes, asegurando su correcta evolución y operatividad en entornos productivos.
Documentar las soluciones desarrolladas, justificando las decisiones técnicas adoptadas y definiendo los procesos operativos asociados.
Colaborar en los procesos de identificación, evaluación y negociación con proveedores de soluciones analíticas y de IA tradicional y generativa, participando en la definición de los requerimientos técnicos y de control necesarios para el correcto desarrollo de los proyectos.




EXPERIENCIA, CONOCIMIENTOS Y HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS

Experiencia deseada:

Experiencia profesional de al menos 4 años en departamentos de ciencia de datos, con participación en proyectos de analítica avanzada y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial.
Experiencia práctica en proyectos que incorporen modelos de IA generativa (LLMs), e IA agéntica aplicados a casos de negocio reales.
Conocimiento de técnicas de prompting, y de evaluación de sistemas de Gen AI, así como de buenas prácticas para el aseguramiento de la calidad de los sistemas de Gen AI, como pueden ser el uso de guardarraíles.
Se valorará positivamente haber participado en proyectos del sector del seguro y haber trabajado en otras compañías aseguradoras.
Experiencia en trabajo en equipo.
Experiencia en coordinación y liderazgo de proyectos analíticos y de IA.
Conocimientos avanzados matemáticos y estadísticos, y en técnicas de preparación de datos en bruto (estructurados y no estructurados, incluyendo texto) y creación de modelos de Machine Learning de diferente tipología tales como series temporales, modelos de regresión y apoyo a soluciones de IA generativa.
Experiencia en evaluación, monitorización y mejora de modelos y soluciones de IA generativa, incluyendo métricas de calidad, uso y control de resultados.
Se valorará positivamente el doctorado.




Conocimientos Requeridos:

Conocimientos de Python y PySpark, aplicados al desarrollo de soluciones analíticas y de Inteligencia Artificial.
Conocimientos prácticos en el uso de modelos de IA generativa (LLMs) aplicados a casos de negocio.
Conocimiento de métricas y técnicas de evaluación, monitorización y control de calidad en soluciones de IA.
Conocimiento de principios de calidad del dato, seguridad y cumplimiento aplicables a proyectos de analítica avanzada y de IA.
Licenciatura o Grado en Informática, Matemáticas, Físicas, Ingeniería u otra carrera técnica.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Smadex is a leading advertising technology company founded in Barcelona in 2011 and sold to American-based and stock-listed Entravision in 2018 (NYSE::EVC). We are a fully transparent platform built with top technology, countless programmatic management features and powerful machine learning algorithms to help advertisers grow their business at scale. We are currently considered one of the top mobile ad-tech companies in the world.




As a Senior Data Scientist, you won’t just analyze data, you will actively shape the future of our mobile advertising platform. You will sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and business, transforming raw behavioral data from millions of global users into scalable strategies. We are looking for a high-caliber professional who thrives in ambiguity, sets high analytical standards, and translates complex insights into product decisions.




This is a full-time position based in Barcelona.




Product & ML Strategy Influence

Own the analytical loop that influences our Product and Machine Learning strategies. Use data to identify untapped opportunities and define what we build next.
Design, execute, and evaluate sophisticated experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, multivariate testing) to measure the impact of new product features and ML algorithms.
Establish and govern key performance frameworks to align cross-functional teams on what success looks like.




Scalable Analytics & Frameworks

Build reproducible data models, frameworks, and processes that allow the company to scale decision-making without reinventing the wheel.
Design high-impact data visualization assets that democratize data access and enable self-service insights for both technical and commercial stakeholders.




Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as the strategic data partner for engineering, product, and business teams, translating deep technical findings into actionable, high-level business recommendations.
Raise the bar for analytical rigor across the organization, mentoring junior team members and establishing best practices.




Skills & Requirements

Experience: 5+ years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or Product Analyst, preferably in high-growth tech environments or mobile ecosystems.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Economics).
Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience working with massive, complex datasets and modern cloud data warehouses
Statistical Rigor: Solid understanding of statistical concepts, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and regression methodologies.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to present complex technical conclusions to C-level executives and non-technical stakeholders with clarity and impact.
Ownership & Autonomy: Proven track record of owning projects from ambiguity to measurable business outcome. You are comfortable building the playbook, not just following it.




Preferred Qualifications (A Plus)

Strong background in the ad-tech industry, mobile programmatic advertising (DSP/SSP), or user acquisition (UA) dynamics.
Familiarity with mobile app measurement frameworks (MMPs) and concepts like LTV optimization or incrementality.
Experience working with global, distributed cross-functional teams.




Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered.







What is in it for you:

Integrate a highly motivated, young and dynamic team
Great compensation package
Top location at the heart of Barcelona with a rooftop terrace, Barbecue, and a fully stocked fridge
Great work-life balance: work from home (2 days per week), flexible hours
Meal vouchers - Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance
Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR and Wellhub
LinkedIn Learning and training opportunities
Monthly TGIF events
Regular team-building events
Fun and friendly work environment with talented marketers and engineers from over 40 countries
And more!

Title: Data Scientist - Fraud Detection
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Scientist to join our Anti Fraud Team.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle fraud, one of the most impactful and fast-evolving challenges in insurance. You will do this from a global perspective. In fact, the team is responsible for detecting fraudulent claims across all Prima markets: the UK, Spain and Italy.

You’ll collaborate with engineers, claims handlers and business leaders to improve the detection of fraud, directly influencing real-world fraud decisions with impact on the company’s bottom line measured in millions. This is a highly practical area of work where strong business judgment is just as important as technical expertise.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Design and improve fraud detection systems that prioritize high-risk claims, optimizing the trade-off between detection accuracy and operational efficiency
Collaborate across teams and functions, working closely with fraud analysts, engineers, and product managers
Develop deep expertise in fraud dynamics, identifying emerging fraud patterns, understanding how they evolve across the insurance lifecycle, and translating these insights into effective detection and prevention strategies, for example identifying suspicious networks of related claims, synthetic entities, or anomalous behavioral patterns


What We’re Looking For


Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact
Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity
Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong Python programming skills, especially in the data domain, and fluent use of Git
Knowledge of Spark, SQL or any other data-oriented programming language and proficiency with standard data wrangling and modeling libraries (Pandas, Sklearn, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.)


Nice-to-Have


Experience in analytical fraud detection in the Insurance, Finance or Law Enforcement domain
In-depth knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) and analytics (NetworkX, GNN) or explainability applied to anomaly detection
Knowledge of BI tools (Tableau or similar)


€45,000 - €65,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 5% of the fixed salary for this position.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: DATA SCIENTIST ADVANCED ANALYTICS
Description:
Descripción del puesto:



¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Sobre el equipo

En Advanced Analytics trabajamos para crear valor para la organización a partir de la explotación de datos. Nuestro equipo colabora transversalmente con 40 áreas del Grupo CaixaBank, creando soluciones con impacto en el negocio: contribuimos a mejorar la toma de decisiones, optimizar procesos, personalizar la relación con los clientes y descubrir nuevas oportunidades de eficiencia y crecimiento.


Además, impulsamos el Analytics Community en CaixaBank, una comunidad orientada a fomentar la cultura data-driven, compartir conocimiento, divulgar buenas prácticas y desarrollar capacidades analíticas, con iniciativas como OlympIA, las Sesiones Analytics, o el Portal de Analítica Avanzada (https://portalanaliticaavanzada.lacaixa.es/). 

 

Sobre la posición

Buscamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para participar en el diseño y desarrollo de casos de uso analíticos, cuya misión es construir soluciones robustas y accionables para resolver problemas de negocio.
La persona seleccionada combinará capacidades técnicas avanzadas y orientación a impacto, trabajando de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, tecnología, datos y otras áreas especialistas. 

 

Responsabilidades:

Desarrollar soluciones analíticas orientadas a resolver problemas reales del banco. Las soluciones suelen involucrar la creación de modelos predictivos, segmentaciones, sistemas de scoring, modelos de optimización o análisis avanzados según las necesidades del caso de uso. 
Aplicar buenas prácticas de validación, interpretabilidad, robustez y monitorización de las soluciones.
Colaborar con áreas de negocio para asegurar que las soluciones analíticas responden a necesidades reales y se integran en procesos de decisión:
Comunicando resultados analíticos de forma efectiva, adaptando el mensaje en función del tipo de audiencia.
Acompañando los equipos usuarios en la adopción de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Contribuir a la preparación de materiales, sesiones, formaciones o contenidos para la Analytics Community.

Requisitos mínimos

Formación

Grado o máster en disciplinas cuantitativas, como ingenierías, Ciencia de Datos, Física o similar.
Se valorará formación específica en Machine Learning, Inteligencia Artificial o Analítica Avanzada.

 

Experiencia

Experiencia previa de al menos 2 años en desarrollo de modelos analíticos, machine learning o ciencia de datos aplicada a problemas de negocio.
Se valorará experiencia en consultoría.
Experiencia colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares, combinando interlocución con negocio y desarrollo técnico.
Se valorará experiencia en industrialización, monitorización o puesta en producción de modelos.

Competencias clave

Excelente nivel de programación en Python para análisis de datos, modelización y automatización.
Conocimiento sólido de librerías de data science y machine learning (p.ej. scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy)
Excelente nivel de SQL/Big Query para extracción, transformación y análisis de datos.
Buenas prácticas de documentación, reproducibilidad y calidad del código.

Nice to have:

Experiencia con plataformas cloud, en particular GCP.
Conocimiento de herramientas de visualización y BI, p.ej. QlikSense o Looker.
Experiencia con modelos de IA generativa.
Conocimiento de MLOps: versionado, monitorización y control de performance.

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Sobre el equipo

En Advanced Analytics trabajamos para crear valor para la organización a partir de la explotación de datos. Nuestro equipo colabora transversalmente con 40 áreas del Grupo CaixaBank, creando soluciones con impacto en el negocio: contribuimos a mejorar la toma de decisiones, optimizar procesos, personalizar la relación con los clientes y descubrir nuevas oportunidades de eficiencia y crecimiento.


Además, impulsamos el Analytics Community en CaixaBank, una comunidad orientada a fomentar la cultura data-driven, compartir conocimiento, divulgar buenas prácticas y desarrollar capacidades analíticas, con iniciativas como OlympIA, las Sesiones Analytics, o el Portal de Analítica Avanzada (https://portalanaliticaavanzada.lacaixa.es/). 

 

Sobre la posición

Title: Data Scientist – Generative AI Specialist
HTML:
We are looking for Generative AI Specialists (junior, intermediate, and middle-senior profiles) to join BIP’s xTech Competence Centre, one of the largest Data Science communities in Europe.

You will work on advanced AI projects for leading enterprise clients across multiple industries, developing Generative AI solutions for real business use cases. You will be involved in initiatives leveraging pre-trained models (such as LLMs) as well as training and fine-tuning new models, especially in contexts with unstructured data (text, images, video, and audio).

In addition, you will actively contribute to the internal AI Community through research, technology scouting, solution design, and business development initiatives.

Mandatory Requirements
  • Master’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Mathematical Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or related STEM disciplines;
  • Strong quantitative mindset and analytical skills;
  • Passion and expertise in data exploration, data analysis, and model development;
  • Strong knowledge of Statistics, Data Mining, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning;
  • Solid programming experience in Python;
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git);
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL programming;
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis);
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., ChromaDB, Qdrant, Pinecone);
  • Experience using AI Cloud APIs from at least one major provider (Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS);
  • Experience processing unstructured data;
  • Strong knowledge of NLP and Computer Vision techniques (Text Categorization, Entity Extraction, Generation, Object Detection, Segmentation);
  • Experience with Neural Networks, CNNs, and Transformers;
  • Knowledge of Generative AI techniques and Large Language Models (LLMs);
  • Experience in neural network training and fine-tuning techniques (e.g., Super-Convergence, PEFT, LoRA);
  • Experience with major deep learning libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and model repositories (Hugging Face);
  • Knowledge of prompting techniques (one-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought);
  • Fluent professional proficiency in Spanish and English (mandatory).


Nice to Have
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Experience developing and applying Generative AI models in industrial environments;
  • Software development experience and strong knowledge of SDLC;
  • Experience with data/model versioning frameworks (MLflow, DVC);
  • Experience with generative networks for controlled content production (text, images, video);
  • Experience building Search Engines, Entity Extraction systems, or Image Anomaly Detection solutions;
  • Knowledge of Explainable AI models (SHAP, LIME, Anchors);
  • Experience working in Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Knowledge of Data Engineering concepts (ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, distributed processing);
  • Experience with big data frameworks such as Apache Spark;
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (workspace management, notebooks, Delta Lake, MLflow integration);
  • Experience designing scalable data architectures in cloud environments.


Soft Skills
  • Strong consulting mindset;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Client-oriented and results-driven;
  • Teamwork attitude;
  • Attention to detail and ability to work under deadlines.


Why BIP?

Growth & Learning

Access to 300+ courses on emerging technologies and business topics, personalized development programs, and continuous training initiatives to support your professional and personal growth.

Flexibility & Work-Life Integration

Hybrid working model with flexibility to balance remote and office work in agreement with your manager and project needs, plus initiatives supporting work-life balance.

Health & Benefits

Private health insurance, wellness platforms, meal vouchers, and an attractive benefits package.

Family & Parenthood

Support for new parents, including enhanced parental leave benefits and dedicated initiatives during and after parental leave.

Inclusion & Values

We promote uniqueness and equal opportunities for everyone. We are committed to creating an ethical, inclusive, and welcoming work environment.

Next Steps

Once we receive your CV, we will carefully review your profile. If there is a match with this or other open positions within the Group, we will contact you to start our mutual introduction process.

The selection process generally includes an HR interview, a technical interview with a Line Manager, and potentially a final interview with a Partner. The number and order of interviews may vary.

About Us

Founded in 2003, BIP combines the historical excellence of management consulting with innovation and digitalization. Today we are more than 5,000 professionals across 13 countries, delivering over 4,500 projects worldwide.

We support our clients in driving large-scale impact through Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IoT, and disruptive technologies across all industries.

We believe in excellence as our guiding principle and adopt an ethical and fair approach toward everyone who chooses to work with us, fostering an environment where people grow together through diverse expertise.

Title: Data Scientist Machine Learning Engineer

Como Data Scientist participarás en el diseño, desarrollo y puesta en producción de soluciones analíticas avanzadas, colaborando estrechamente con equipos de negocio y tecnología.

Buscamos una persona apasionada por los datos, con sólida base técnica y ganas de participar en proyectos de analítica avanzada, desarrollando soluciones que generen impacto real en el negocio.

Formarás parte de un equipo estratégico con acceso a grandes volúmenes de información y tecnologías punteras dentro del ecosistema de datos.




Tus principales responsabilidades serán:




• Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos para identificar patrones, oportunidades y áreas de mejora.

• Desarrollar modelos predictivos y algoritmos de Machine Learning para diferentes casos de uso de negocio (scoring crediticio, fraude, marketing / churn, pricing, collections).

• Diseñar y mantener procesos de entrenamiento, validación y monitorización de modelos.

• Participar en la automatización y despliegue de soluciones analíticas.

• Colaborar con Data Engineers y equipos de negocio para asegurar la correcta explotación de los datos.

• Construir procesos de análisis reproducibles y escalables.

• Participar en iniciativas relacionadas con Inteligencia Artificial e IA Generativa.

• Elaborar visualizaciones y comunicar resultados a diferentes áreas de la compañía. Requisitos del puesto




Requisitos

• Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones relacionadas con Data Science, Machine Learning o Advanced Analytics.

• Nivel avanzado de Python.

• Nivel avanzado de SQL.

• Experiencia desarrollando modelos de Machine Learning utilizando Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM o librerías similares.

• Conocimientos sólidos de estadística aplicada y análisis de datos.

• Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de información.

• Conocimiento de herramientas de visualización de datos como Power BI o Tableau.

• Experiencia utilizando Git y buenas prácticas de desarrollo.

• Grado universitario o ingeniería




Valorable

• Experiencia con Spark o tecnologías Big Data.

• Conocimientos de MLOps y ciclo de vida de modelos.

• Experiencia con MLflow, Azure ML o plataformas similares.

• Conocimientos de Docker.

• Experiencia en entornos cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP).

• Experiencia con modelos de IA Generativa y Large Language Models (LLMs).

• Conocimientos de Data Engineering.

• Inglés, no imprescindible.




Qué ofrecemos

- Beneficios sociales: seguro médico y de vida.

- Contrato Indefinido.

- Teletrabajo: 3 días presencial 2 días en casa.

- Desarrollo y crecimiento profesional.

- Formación interna y externa.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Descripció de l'empresa




Dribia som un estudi d’innovació en ciència de dades: dissenyem algoritmes d’optimització i predicció a partir de la detecció de patrons en les dades. Despleguem els nostres algoritmes per crear solucions de software a mida basades en analítica avançada de dades i intel·ligència artificial.

Som un equip amb experiència, creatiu i potent tècnicament. Combinem una contrastada trajectòria en consultoria privada en ciència de dades amb una sòlida formació acadèmica. Hem executat projectes per empreses de diversos sectors que inclouen: previsió de vendes, optimització de processos, recomanació de productes, previsió de fugues de clients o anàlisi del llenguatge natural entre d’altres.

Aquest talent el canalitzem a través d’una metodologia àgil pròpia, específica per a projectes de dades i àmpliament validada. Lliurem solucions completes end-to-end basades en codi obert, documentat i totalment transferible als nostres clients (sense restriccions d'IP i llicències). A més, proveïm del suport necessari perquè el client pugui integrar i operar amb les solucions lliurades autònomament




Descripció de tasques




Projecte amb client

Els equips en un projecte de desenvolupament estàndard consisteix en un equip de dedicació total 1.4 FTE1. Aquest equip està liderat per un responsable de Projecte (RP) al 40%, un o dos desenvolupadors principals (Dev), amb un total de dedicació del 100%, i un possible suport amb dedicació variable. Aquesta dedicació pot variar en funció de

l’experiència del científic de dades, dels requisits del client i de les particularitats del projecte. En general l’activitat de projecte es duu a terme a les oficines de Dribia (o en remot) i, si les condicions ho permeten, les presentacions de final d’sprint es duen a terme a les oficines del client (1 dia cada dues setmanes).

A Dribia som conscients que la creativitat requereix diàleg i perspectiva. En aquesta línia, a part de l'equip amb dedicació intensiva en el projecte, setmanalment organitzem seminaris de discussió sobre els projectes actius, on l'equip de Dribia al complet contribueix al disseny i resolució de problemes.




Projectes de manteniment i millores

A Dribia participem de tot el cicle de vida dels projectes i, per tant, un cop entreguem les nostres solucions, també ens encarreguem del seguiment, resolució d’incidències i millores. Aquestes tasques poden estar articulades per bossa d’hores o per una dedicació constant. Sigui quina sigui la fórmula, trimestralment obliguem el client a dedicar les hores no utilitzades en millores incrementals de la solució i, per tant, afegint una part més creativa al

manteniment típic de solucions desplegades.




Projectes interns

Sempre que algú tingui disponibilitat, incentivem la dedicació en la millora d’eines internes: desenvolupament de solucions pròpies, llibreries pròpies, snippets de codi, documentació interna, etc. Si es considera oportú, aquestes eines es poden alliberar i publicar en llicències de codi obert. La metodologia de treball en els projectes interns serà la més similar possible a la feta servir amb els clients. Iterativa i entregables cada 2 setmanes.




Redacció de propostes.

Els científics de dades Sènior poden donar suport a l’equip comercial en la redacció de propostes sobretot en la definició de la solució algorítmica i planificació, així com la dedicació aproximada per a cada una de les fases. No s’envia cap proposta comercial a un client sense l’acord de l’equip de projecte proposat. Si es requereix una defensa presencial de la proposta, hi participa tot l’equip, on cada u es presentarà i el responsable del projecte defensarà la part tècnica i planificació del projecte.




Desenvolupament d’eines internes i formació

Incentivem preparar i dur a terme sessions de formació interna per tal de difondre les noves eines desenvolupades, coneixements que es creguin rellevants o compartir reptes dels projectes. Aquestes sessions les anomenem Pizza Slides i es duen a terme cada un o dos divendres a les oficines abans de dinar (dinar a càrrec de Dribia).




Requisits dels candidats

Llicenciatura o grau amb un alt contingut en matemàtiques i estadística (per exemple física o matemàtiques) amb experiència en desenvolupament de programari en Python. Els coneixements en algorítmia i/o intel·ligència artificial són desitjables però no imprescindibles. Per sobre de tot valorem el talent, la comunicació, la creativitat, i

l’organització.

Data Scientist Júnior

Grau + mínim de 2 anys d’experiència en programació.

Data Scientist

Experiència de 4 anys en programació (sigui màster o laboral) o un doctorat amb ús intensiu de l’estadística i la programació.

Sènior Data Scientist

Experiència de 6 anys en programació i experiència laboral de 3 anys en el sector privat de les ciències de dades.

Mànager Data Scientist

Experiència mínima de 2 anys com a Sènior Data scientist a Dribia.

Title: Data Scientist, Parameta Solutions (Madrid)
Description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Role Overview

We are on a mission to harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to shape the next generation of financial intelligence solutions. As we continue to expand our Data Science capability, we are seeking a talented and innovative Data Scientist to develop cutting-edge analytical and Generative AI solutions that drive commercial value across our business.

Based in Madrid and working within Parameta Solutions, you will play a key role in designing, developing and deploying scalable data products that transform complex financial data into actionable insights. Working closely with Data Engineering, Product, Commercial and Technology teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, cloud technologies and Generative AI capabilities to support the evolution of our data-driven product suite.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly growing function at the forefront of financial data innovation, helping to shape the future of analytics, intelligence and AI-powered solutions across the organisation.

Role Responsibilities


Design, develop and maintain robust Python-based applications for financial data analysis, transformation, enrichment and automation.
Build scalable data science solutions that extract actionable insights from large and complex financial datasets.
Develop interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks and visualisation tools to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Enhance, support and continuously improve existing data applications, data quality frameworks and analytical platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers and commercial stakeholders to ensure the scalability, reliability and usability of data products and models.
Apply software engineering best practices, including modular development, code reviews, automated testing, version control and CI/CD methodologies.
Design, develop and maintain Generative AI solutions that enhance internal processes, analytical capabilities and customer-facing products.
Leverage AWS cloud technologies and services to build scalable AI and machine learning applications, making full use of innovative capabilities available through our strategic AWS partnership.
Evaluate emerging AI, machine learning and data science technologies, identifying opportunities to improve products, processes and client outcomes.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Parameta Solutions' data science and AI capabilities, helping establish best practices and technical standards across the team.


Experience / Competences

Essential


Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications within a data science, machine learning or quantitative analytics environment.
Demonstrated software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented programming, modular design patterns and version control.
Experience building and deploying analytical, machine learning or AI-driven solutions in a commercial environment.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying and manipulating large-scale datasets.
Experience working with modern data and engineering platforms such as Snowflake, Airflow, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience developing or integrating Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM) or machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated understanding of cloud-based architectures and services, particularly within AWS environments.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.


Desired


Industry experience in a computational or quantitative data science role.
Experience developing customer-facing analytics, recommendation engines or AI-powered products.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and model deployment, monitoring and governance frameworks.
Experience working within agile product and engineering environments.
Passion for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.


Job Band & Level


Professional / 5

At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida - escribir buen código y manejarse con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers.

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).
Tecnologías de bases de datos en cloud (p. ej. AWS) y despliegue en infraestructura cloud de datos/analítica.
Contenedores y pipelines/microservicios (Docker, Kubernetes).
Herramientas de dashboarding (Dash, Tableau).




¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos de forecasting de series temporales (métodos estadísticos clásicos —ARIMA/SARIMA, suavizado exponencial, modelos de espacio de estados— y enfoques ML/probabilísticos) aplicados a problemáticas financieras.
Escribir código limpio, ordenado y bien documentado en Python, aplicando buenas prácticas (modularidad, pruebas, control de versiones) para que los modelos sean reproducibles y mantenibles.
Procesar y modelar datos a gran escala con PySpark, construyendo pipelines eficientes sobre datasets financieros voluminosos.
Crear modelos repetibles, interpretables, dinámicos y escalables, y colaborar con data engineers y leads de negocio en su integración en aplicaciones y herramientas.
Ingeniería de features combinando fuentes internas y externas para mejorar la precisión predictiva.
Apoyar la monitorización, mantenimiento y mejora de los modelos una vez en uso.
Comunicar el enfoque analítico (relevancia, trade-offs) a partners de negocio y traducir resultados a implicaciones financieras accionables.
Trabajar de forma iterativa e incremental en un equipo ágil cross-funcional, buscando mejorar velocidad y calidad sprint a sprint.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa.

También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas.

Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid, la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly!




Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics
Description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Madrid

Compensation: €95,000 - €115,000 / year

Description

Location: Madrid, Spain

Annual Remuneration: €95,000 - €115,000 and discretionary annual bonus

Pay Frequency: Monthly

Probationary Period: 180 days

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3-days per week

TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics based in Madrid.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:


Taking ownership of Kharon's risk propagation and entity analytics system — the engine that evaluates entities in our knowledge graph and surfaces meaningful risk signals to customers
Designing and implementing complex analytical logic that translate nuanced geopolitical and financial risk into structured, interpretable outputs
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and graph-based ML systems that power risk scoring and entity analysis
Partnering closely with Research, Product, and Engineering teams to understand evolving risk frameworks and translate them into robust, maintainable systems
Iterating on the system's architecture to increase the complexity and precision it can handle — this is not a rip-and-replace, but a thoughtful evolution of a system already in production
Exploring how LLMs and other AI techniques can be integrated to handle increasingly complex risk logic


Qualifications


A proven interest or experience in global security, financial crimes, sanctions, export controls, or related domains
4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, with demonstrated ownership of production systems
Strong foundation in statistics and the ability to apply quantitative methods to complex, real-world problems
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and working with graph databases or knowledge graph structures
Experience with graph analysis, graph ML, or network analysis — professional experience is a strong differentiator
Comfort working across research and data engineering contexts — this role spans all three
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and API development
Strong product instincts — able to go deep technically while staying aligned to customer and business outcomes
Bonus: Experience with LLMs or AI-assisted analytical systems


About Kharon

Kharon operates at the nexus of global security and is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible.

From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist, Graph Risk Analytics to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

Disclosures

Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

If you require any adjustment to participate in the recruitment process, please contact apply@kharon.com. You must have the right to work in Europe and Spain. Kharon is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that Kharon will process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation and Spanish data protection legislation. For information about how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice at www.kharon.com/privacy. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, to object to or restrict its processing, and to lodge a complaint with the Spanish data protection authority, the AEPD, at www.aepd.es. To exercise your rights, contact us at apply@kharon.com.

If your application is unsuccessful, your data will be retained for up to 12 months before being securely deleted. If you accept a role, your data will transfer to your employee record.
